cohort: Pregnant women undergoing elective caesarean delivery at ≥ 39 weeks
finding: The best amniotic fluid LBC value to predict TTN was 40.15 × 10(3)/μl, with 82.3% sensitivity and 64.3% specificity.
mod_finding: The study investigated the use of amniotic fluid lamellar body count (LBC) as a potential marker for timing elective cesarean delivery.
